name: Convergence of the Glade
summary: The Zero converges upon the wood: one of the woken returns to the Requiem, and the beast folds into the Nexus.

face.name: Convergence of the Glade

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: You may play this card only if your Rubyfront card is on the field on its Rubyfront side, you control at least 4 Auros Entities and, during this turn, at least one Auros Entity you control was untapped while it was in Stasis. Choose one of the Entities untapped this way and put it into your Requiem Zone. Then flip your Rubyfront onto its Nexus side.

face.flavor: The wood held its breath. Then everything converged on a single point.
